name: Files
description: Browse and manage files on every Fleet node with a file backend.
notes: Frontend implementation lives in pantheon-ui (src/desktop/apps) until the UI phase moves it here; this manifest is the definition.

actions.name: navigate
actions.description: Show a folder in this existing window.

actions.name: select
actions.description: Select an entry in the current folder.

actions.name: open
actions.description: Open an entry; folders navigate in this window and files open in their app.

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Delete the named entries in the current folder.

params.name: one entry name
params.names: or an array of entry names
